test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Indian classical musician, Ustad Rashid Khan was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 2022 for his contribution to which of the following music categories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindustani classical music**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ustad Rashid Khan is a renowned vocalist of **Hindustani classical music**, specifically known for his mastery over the **Kirana Gharana**.
 
• In 2022, he was awarded the prestigious **Padma Bhushan**, India's third-highest civilian award, for his contribution to Indian classical music.
 
• He is celebrated for his expertise in **Khayal**, a form of Hindustani classical vocal music, and his ability to blend tradition with modernity.
 
• Ustad Rashid Khan is also known for his performances of **Thumri**, a semi-classical genre, which showcases his versatility as a musician.
 
• He has been widely acclaimed for his soulful renditions and his innovative approach to **raag improvisations**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindustani Classical Music:**

 
 
• This is one of the two major traditions of Indian classical music, the other being **Carnatic music**.
 
• It primarily emphasizes improvisation and exploration of **raagas** (melodic frameworks).
 
• Key components include **Khayal, Dhrupad, Thumri, Tarana**, and **Tappa**.
 
 
 
• **Kirana Gharana:**
 
 
• A school of Hindustani music known for its emphasis on **slow tempo (vilambit laya)** and intricate note-by-note elaboration of ragas.
 
• It was founded by Ustad Abdul Karim Khan and Ustad Abdul Wahid Khan.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards:**
 
 
• The **Padma Bhushan** is the third-highest civilian award in India after the Padma Vibhushan and Bharat Ratna.
 
• It recognizes distinguished service of a high order in various fields such as art, literature, science, and public affairs.
 
 
 
• **Khayal:**
 
 
• A prominent genre in Hindustani classical music, characterized by its **improvisation** and freedom of expression.
 
• The word "Khayal" means "imagination," emphasizing creativity in performance.
